messages:
maria-cs: Nimbus Labs reached out — want a temporary throughput exemption for APAC (ap-southeast-2) to support a pilot running tonight through Sunday (72h). They asked for a +3x concurrent bump and an IP allowlist. Can we scope?
liang-cs: Do they need a higher per-token rate or more concurrent RPS? Any change to SLA or billing?
maria-cs: They specifically requested concurrent RPS on their prod key from 10 -> 30, rate_window shrink to 10s and a larger burst. Also want these edge IPs allowlisted: 18.205.0.0/16 and 52.64.0.0/14.
raj-am: Renewal in ~6 weeks — this pilot outcome affects negotiation. CS: please confirm once live. Prioritize if safe.
sam-eng: We can do a temporary exception but need capacity checks. ap-southeast-2 pool is at ~78% P95 load currently. A straight 3x across the board risks transient throttles. Recommend a 2-hour canary at 2x, monitor, then full windowed bump if stable.
liang-cs: @ops-bot can you open an internal ticket so infra has the request tracked?
ops-bot: Created ticket INF-3321: temp-rate-exempt for Nimbus Labs — owner: sam-eng, priority: high, linked: #customer-success.
maria-cs: Attaching the config snippet they provided so it's clear what to apply:
```
api_key: nimbus-prod-01
concurrent_rps: 30
rate_window_seconds: 10
burst_limit: 200
region: ap-southeast-2
ip_allowlist:
  - 18.205.0.0/16
  - 52.64.0.0/14
window_expiry: 2026-03-25T22:00:00Z
```
sam-eng: I will validate the snippet against our rate limiter. Need to update routing policy to steer traffic to dedicated pool-A if capacity allows, fallback to shared otherwise. Will also enable a short-lived canary flag and synthetic load checks.
liang-cs: Also confirm logging/billing tags so we can attribute extra spend to the pilot. We should add a tag for chargeback.
sam-eng: Will tag events with "nimbus_burst" and enable request tracing for the key for the duration. I'll post the observability dashboard link in INF-3321 after canary starts.
raj-am: Once canary is green, CS will confirm with the customer and log the pilot outcome for renewal talk.
maria-cs: I'll schedule the customer check-in post-canary and collect feedback. Thanks team :thumbsup:
